                    SOAH ORDER NO. 26
      REITERATING PROCEDURAL REQUIREMENTS; PROVIDING
      INFORMATION REGARDING PREHEARING CONFERENCE;
          ADDRESSING VIDEOCONFERENCE PREPARATION


I.    REITERATING PROCEDURAL REQUIREMENTS FOR INTERVENORS

      Under the procedural schedule in this case, Intervenors have been required to
make certain filings using the Public Utility Commission of Texas (Commission)
 Interchange by set deadlines in order to become parties in this case and avoid
dismissal. The parties must now follow additional procedures to have their testimony
or exhibits become part of the evidentiary record at the hearing. The Commission’s
Interchange shows the administrative record for this proceeding, but filing something
on the Interchange does not make it part of the evidentiary record. For a document
to become part of the evidentiary record, it must be offered and admitted at the
prehearing conference or hearing.


        To that end, the remaining parties to this case are reminded to closely review
the pre- and post-hearing requirements set forth in Section III of SOAH Order No. 6
issued on April 20, 2026.1 Of particular note is the June 3, 2026 deadline for all
parties to submit electronic copies of the following to SOAH, the other parties, and
the court reporter:

        • A list of all witnesses the party intends to call to testify during the hearing,
          listed in the order that the party intends to call them.

        • A list of all witnesses the party intends to cross-examine during the hearing.

        • A list of all exhibits the party intends to offer at the hearing (including
          cross-examination exhibits, if known prior to the hearing). For exhibits that
          were prefiled on the Commission’s Interchange (e.g., testimony), please
          include the Interchange filing number on the exhibit list.

        • A copy of each exhibit included on the party’s exhibit list. The exhibits
          must be paginated and marked with the offering party’s name and exhibit
          number.




1 Interchange Item No. 788.

                                                      2
                                            SOAH Order No. 26
                              SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349, PUC Docket No. 59475
 These submissions serve a different purpose than the parties’ previous filings, and
the parties must submit these materials to SOAH (via Kiteworks) and serve them on
the other parties and the court reporter (via Applicants’ file-sharing site) by the
deadline even if they have previously filed the same or similar information on the
Interchange. Uploading these materials to Kiteworks and serving them on the other
parties is how you will indicate the exhibits you are offering into evidence. The
Administrative Law Judges (ALJs) will rely on the parties’ Kiteworks submissions in
determining which exhibits are admitted into evidence.


        For information on uploading exhibits to Kiteworks, review SOAH Order
No. 6 issued on April 20, 2026.2


        For information on uploading exhibits to the Applicants’ file-sharing site,
review the “Roadmap for Hearing Exhibits” filed by Applicants on June 1, 2026.3


II.     PREHEARING CONFERENCE

        A prehearing conference is scheduled for June 5, 2026, at 1:00 p.m., via
videoconference. For ease of reference, the login information is repeated below:

   Join by computer or smart device:                        Join by telephone (audio only):
   Go to https://soah-texas.zoomgov.com                     Call +1 669 254 5252
   and enter the following:                                 and enter the following:
   Meeting ID:             161 003 7736                     Meeting ID:             161 003 7736
   Passcode:               PUC6349                          Passcode:               4577035

2 Interchange Item No. 788. For questions about Kiteworks, contact SOAH’s Docketing Division at 512-475-4993.

3 Interchange Item No. 5337.

                                                       3
                                             SOAH Order No. 26
                               SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349, PUC Docket No. 59475
        At the prehearing conference, the ALJs will admit exhibits, address pending
motions, and discuss hearing procedures. All parties who intend to participate in
the hearing should attend the prehearing conference.


       If a party experiences technical difficulties with joining any hearing, they
should contact SOAH’s Docketing Division at (512) 475-4993.


       Non-party observers should view the proceedings on YouTube in lieu of
joining the Zoom videoconference. The prehearing conference will be livestreamed
on SOAH’s YouTube channel at: https://www.youtube.com/@TexasSOAH.


III.   ZOOM PREPARATION

       The prehearing conference will be held by Zoom videoconference and the
hearing on the merits will be a hybrid hearing—i.e., some participants will attend
in-person in Austin, but most participants have indicated they will be attending
remotely by Zoom.


       Each party attending in person needs to have and maintain a connection
to Zoom. Any exhibits shown to an in-person witness must also be displayed via
screen-sharing in Zoom so that remote parties can see the materials as well.


       Prior to the hearing, all parties should log into Zoom and familiarize
themselves with the following basic features:

       • Make sure your name and (if applicable) who you represent are visible in
         the corner of your screen.
                                             4
                                   SOAH Order No. 26
                     SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349, PUC Docket No. 59475
       • Know how to mute and unmute yourself. Parties should be muted any time
        they are not speaking.
      • Know how to turn your camera on and off. Cameras should generally be
        turned off unless you are speaking or questioning a witness.
      • Know how to use the Raise Hand (and Lower Hand) feature.
      • For anyone who will be referring to exhibits during their
        cross-examination, familiarize yourself with the screen-sharing feature and
        have the exhibits you will be using saved where you can quickly access them
        on your computer.

Signed June 2, 2026
